steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Resident Evil 2 (N64) Nintendo 64 USA revision 1 ROM. Check the required size and SHA-1 in games/re2-us-v1/profile.toml before importing. Keep the original separately. These instructions do not download or run it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use tools/import_rom.py --profile games/re2-us-v1/profile.toml to normalize your own .z64, .n64 or .v64 ROM. Build the CMake re2-us-v1-release target to produce the native re2-us-v1 player. The default keeps the ROM external; an optional build that embeds it must remain private. This is manual setup from source; Portcove-managed download and completed setup or gameplay checks are not offered.
